title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
content: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
content: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
content: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
content: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
content: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.

title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
content: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
content: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
content: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

title: Ex-FTX COO calls out Netflix over CZ’s ‘Asian mafia’ portrayal
content: Constance Waing said Netflix used racist stereotypes in its portrayal of CZ and misrepresented life at FTX before the exchange’s collapse.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
content: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
content: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
content: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

title: Morning Minute: Ethereum Focuses on Security As AI Threats Rise
content: The Ethereum Foundation pulls its quantum-resistance deadline forward to end 2028, as AI labs say their next models are too dangerous.

title: French Senate Rejects Plan to Make Crypto Holders Declare Self-Custody Wallets
content: Holders had warned that reporting wallets worth over €100,000 could expose them to risk in a country hit by a wave of crypto kidnappings.

title: HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes
content: Bitcoin Magazine HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes HRF's Bitcoin Development Fund backed seven projects for self-custody, privacy and education under repression, from phone wallets to solar mining in Nigeria. title: CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss
content: Bitcoin Magazine CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss CleanSpark's CFO said the miner may sell more bitcoin than it mines to reduce risk after a $987.1 million fiscal 2026 loss, as its shares hit a new 52-week low. This post CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push
content: Bitcoin Magazine Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push Next Technology sold about 500 BTC for $29.22 million to fund AI work, cutting its holdings to 5,333 BTC, and said it does not expect to buy more bitcoin. This post Next Technology (NXTT) Sells 500 Bitcoin to Fund AI Push first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open The bitcoin price fell to near $57,500 Wednesday as the Nasdaq sank 4% at the open on a deepening tech selloff, hot core PCE inflation and new U.S. tariff proposals. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
